program_overview.title: MySQL Database Masterclass
program_overview.tagline: The data layer, owned end to end: SQL fluency, real schema design, the programmable database, and the production habits developers are actually judged on.
program_overview.description:
Every application stands on a database, and every serious interview eventually reaches SQL. This live online masterclass takes college students and professionals from zero to genuine capability in seven months: SQL written fluently, schemas designed rather than accumulated, the programmable side of MySQL (views, stored procedures, triggers, transactions), Python integration where data becomes application, and the production basics, security, backups and performance tuning, that separate developers who use databases from developers databases can trust.

The scope is deliberately honest. Full database administration, replication clusters, multi-cloud failover, is its own profession, and courses that staple it onto a beginner syllabus produce neither developers nor DBAs. This course builds the 95% that developers, analysts and interviews actually demand, names the DBA path clearly for those who want it next, and spends the reclaimed months making the fundamentals genuinely deep: joins that never confuse, EXPLAIN read like a native, transactions understood well enough to argue about.

The pace is honest: seven months at two live classes a week plus three to four hours of practice, with an eighth month in hand. Problem sets after every class, monthly mixed reviews, and a final exam, practical plus written, that decides the certificate with a free retest after revision. Real queries, real design, depth over dopamine.
what_makes_this_different: Honest scope: the developer 95%, not a stapled-on DBA career track
Design is taught as a craft: ER modeling, normalization and constraints, practiced on real domains
The programmable database gets real weeks: views, procedures, triggers and transactions, not a demo each
EXPLAIN fluency: performance tuning taught as reading, reasoning and measuring
Ends integrated: MySQL driven from Python, with security, backups and tuning as habits
Real assessment: weekly problem sets, monthly mixed reviews, and a final exam that decides the certificate, with focused revision and a free retest

Named next steps: data analytics, full-stack development, or the dedicated DBA path

faqs.question: Is this course only about writing SQL queries?
faqs.answer: No, and that is the point. Queries are phase 1; the course continues into schema design as a craft, the programmable database, views, stored procedures, triggers and transactions, Python integration, and the production habits of security, backups and EXPLAIN-driven performance tuning. What it deliberately does not staple on is the full DBA career track, replication clusters and multi-cloud failover, which is its own profession and is named honestly as a next path.

faqs.question: How long does it take to learn MySQL properly?
faqs.answer: Seven months at 2 live classes a week plus 3 to 4 hours of practice covers the developer 95%: SQL fluency, design, the programmable database and production basics. The course keeps an eighth month in hand for learners who need more repetition, no rushing and no penalty. Twelve-month database courses are stretched; two-week ones are demos.

faqs.question: How am I assessed? Is the certificate just for attending?
faqs.answer: No. Problem sets follow every class with written feedback, monthly reviews deliberately mix new topics with earlier ones, each phase ends with an exam, and the course ends with a final exam, a practical build plus written questions from the whole syllabus. Passing earns the certificate; falling short earns focused revision and a free retest.

faqs.question: Do I need programming experience to start?
faqs.answer: No. SQL is taught from the first statement and is one of the friendliest languages to begin with. The Python integration weeks in phase 3 are guided and assume nothing; students who already code simply move faster there.

faqs.question: Which MySQL version and tools do you teach?
faqs.answer: Current MySQL 8 with MySQL Workbench, all free Community editions, plus the command line where professionals actually live. Everything taught transfers to MariaDB and, concepts-wise, to PostgreSQL; SQL fluency is portable by design.

faqs.question: How does this help with placements and interviews?
faqs.answer: SQL rounds are near-universal in data and software hiring, and they test exactly what this course drills: joins under pressure, subqueries, aggregation edge cases, schema design judgment and transaction reasoning. The monthly mixed reviews keep older material interview-fresh, and the capstone gives you a designed, tuned, documented database to talk through.

faqs.question: What are the fees?
faqs.answer: Group classes are ₹1,499 per month, with 2 live classes a week in batches capped at 10 learners. A mini batch of 3-4 learners is ₹2,999 per month, and personal 1-on-1 classes are ₹4,999 per month. International learners pay a price set for their own country, shown on this page in their local currency.

faqs.question: Can I evaluate the teaching first?
faqs.answer: Yes, a free demo class with no commitment: book at learn.modernagecoders.com/contact or message us on WhatsApp at +91 91233 66161. Bring a query from your own work or coursework; the demo is best on your real problem.

faqs.question: Are classes live or recorded?
faqs.answer: Live, always: small groups where your actual SQL gets read and corrected in real time, never pre-recorded videos. Database judgment is built under feedback; a video cannot see your execution plan.
